title: Normalized zero extension of a natural tensor total
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $A,B$ be cochain complexes of $k$-vector spaces indexed by $\mathbb N$. Let $E$ denote extension by zero to $\mathbb Z$, and let $T=\operatorname{Tot}(A\otimes_k B)$ use the signed differential [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. There exists an isomorphism $c:\operatorname{Tot}(EA\otimes_k EB)\cong ET$ of cochain complexes. For every $p+q=n$ and $a\in A^p$, $b\in B^q$, the map $c^n$ sends the integer total coprojection of the tensor of the inverse canonical extension term comparisons applied to $a,b$ to the inverse canonical extension term comparison of the natural total coprojection of $a\otimes b$. This specifies the coprojection normalization, and asserts no homology or Kunneth equivalence.

proof.text: Apply tensorTotal_extend_nat to A and B to obtain an extension isomorphism s and its morphism-level coprojection identity.

For a natural pair p+q=n, substitute n=p+q. Evaluate the coprojection identity on the tensor of the inverse factor extension comparisons applied to a and b. Tensor-map evaluation and the two factor hom-inverse identities reduce its right-hand side to the natural coprojection of a tensor b. Apply the inverse total extension comparison to both sides and cancel its inverse-hom composite. This proves exactly the required elementwise normalization.

theorem tensorTotal_extend_natural_iso {k : Type w} [Field k]
    (A B : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{w} k) ℕ) :
    let E := ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat
    let T := mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    let S := mapBifunctor (A.extend E) (B.extend E)
      (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    ∃ c : S ≅ T.extend E,
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n})
        (a : A.X i.val.1) (b : B.X i.val.2),
        c.hom.f (n : ℤ)
          (ιMapBifunctor (A.extend E) (B.extend E) (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (i.val.1 : ℤ) (i.val.2 : ℤ) (n : ℤ) (by
              change (i.val.1 : ℤ) + (i.val.2 : ℤ) = (n : ℤ)
              exact_mod_cast i.property)
            (((A.extendXIso E (i := i.val.1) rfl).inv a) ⊗ₜ[k]
              ((B.extendXIso E (i := i.val.2) rfl).inv b))) =
          (T.extendXIso E (i := n) rfl).inv
            (ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
              i.val.1 i.val.2 n i.property (a ⊗ₜ[k] b))
